    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    strips = [(r, [grid[r][c] for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]) for r in range(h)]
    palette_row = next((vals for r, vals in strips if len(vals) > 1 and len(set(vals)) == len(vals)
                        and all(grid[r][c] == grid[r+1][c] == grid[r+2][c] for c in range(w)
                                if grid[r][c] != 0 and r+2 < h)), None)
    if palette_row is None:
        # In the demo, the palette is a vertical run of colors, one per row.
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
        palette = []
        for c in cols:

            if vals and vals[0] not in palette:

    sh = r1-r0+1

            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
